## Stage A requirements (this run)
1. **Readable agent-error observability sink** (REQUIRED; D-P0.15e-4 / D-P0.06-1) — agent-entry captures a
   thrown SDK/engine error into `.rhema/agent-result.json`; harness reads it + surfaces it as a run event
   (`engine.error`, internal) + the failStep reason, so a crash is queryable from `run_events`/`steps` with no
   pod exec. NO secret / user content (error class + bounded message only).
2. **Worker GKE-Job launcher without out-of-band** (REQUIRED; D-P0.15e-3) — chosen: **option (b)** build the
   KubeConfig from the GKE endpoint + CA + a per-launch metadata OAuth token (keeps the proven Cloud Run worker
   topology; thin unit-testable seam). pulumi preview/tsc clean.
3. **Proxy SSE/streaming pass** (D-P0.07-5) — implement defensively: stream the response through incrementally
   while metering the accumulated body once. Offline-constructable + unit-testable; closes the coding half of
   D-P0.07-5; de-risks Stage B regardless of which of pre-SDK-hang vs buffering is THE D-P0.15e-2 cause
   (confirmed live in Stage B).
4. **Konnectivity/pod-log egress** (D-P0.15e-4) — investigate network.ts; item-1 sink is the primary mechanism.
   Record whether an IaC gap exists.

### LIVE FINDINGS (the real root causes, diagnosed with logs in hand)
- **D-P0.15e-3 CLOSED LIVE:** the Cloud Run worker launched the two-uid GKE Job via the metadata-token launcher, NO out-of-band step. Job + pod ran.
- **D-P0.15e-4 (pod logs) — real IaC gaps found + fixed:** konnectivity-agent dials `<master>:8132` (not just 443/10250) → firewall missing 8132 → "No agent available". Added 8132 (live + network.ts). Then `kubectl logs` failed "dial <node>:10250 i/o timeout" → node→node kubelet egress blocked by deny-all → added `sandbox-node-kubelet` egress (live + network.ts). After both: `kubectl logs`/`exec` WORK.
- **D-P0.15e-2 (agent→proxy) — TRUE ROOT CAUSE (NOT SDK hang / NOT proxy buffering):** with logs, the pod fails `Error: spawn setpriv ENOENT`. The agent is NEVER spawned. Cause: `buildAgentLaunch` spawns bare `setpriv` + bare `node`, but the scrubbed agent env FORBIDS PATH (assertScrubbed) → Node can't resolve them. P0.15e misattributed this as "agent never reaches proxy" (logs were unreachable). FIX: absolute `/usr/bin/setpriv` (bootstrap.ts) + `process.execPath` for node (harness-main.ts). Also found: NetworkPolicy blocked the WI metadata server (169.254.169.254) the harness needs for GCS auth → added it (infra/k8s + applied live).
- Rebuilding run-task image with the setpriv/node fix; then re-run to verify a green phase.
